name: Membership Query Complexity of Addressing
proof: The r bit coordinates, with $r=\lceil\log_2n\rceil$, identify the target because its encoding is injective. Conversely, a binary membership-query decision tree of worst-case depth q has at most $2^q$ leaves, and must distinguish all n targets, so $q\ge\lceil\log_2n\rceil$. This includes zero queries at n=1.
